title: The Labor Day Deals Have Already Started. This Is the On-Sale Tech Gear I’d Shop
author: Nena Farrell
text: All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.It's never too early for deals, and the sales have already started popping up for Labor Day. While the holiday is a little later than usual this year (falling on Monday, September 7), that hasn't stopped plenty of our favorite tech gear from going on sale, from Dyson vacuums to Apple AirTags and even Sony's WH-1000XM6 headphones.Every item we feature is a tech gadget the WIRED Reviews team has tested and loved, usually a top pick from our guides, ranging from headphones and speakers to vacuums and chargers. We'll be keeping an eye on the sales leading up to and through the holiday, so don't miss your chance to get something off your tech wish list for a better price with these Labor Day sales.WIRED Featured Tech DealsA Handy Bluetooth TrackerApple AirTag (2nd Generation)Jump to review$29 $24 (17% off) AmazonThe Best of Dyson’s New VacsDyson V10 KonicalJump to review$650 $550 (15% off) Dyson (with Auto-empty Dok)The Best Bluetooth SpeakerJBL Flip 7Jump to review$150 $95 (37% off) Best BuyEarbuds for EveryoneGoogle Pixel Buds 2aJump to review$129 $99 (23% off) Amazon4 / 4Early Gadget Deals for Labor DayPhotograph: AlamyPhotograph: James D. It has the new Dyson vacuum head, the All Floor Cones, and is usually on sale for the same price as the V8 Cyclone. However, the V10 Konical did better in my testing. While the base vacuum isn't on sale right now, the version with the Auto-empty Dok is. That means you can get a great all-around Dyson that's already well-priced, plus a docking station that both empties and charges the vacuum.Early Speaker and Headphone Deals for Labor DayPhotograph: Ryan WaniataPhotograph: Ryan WaniataPhotograph: Ryan WaniataJBLFlip 7$150 $95 (37% off) Best Buy$150 $95 (37% off) Amazon$150 $95 (37% off) Walmart$150 $95 (37% off) JBLThe best Bluetooth speaker is the JBL Flip 7, and it's on sale for a little more than $50 off ahead of Labor Day. Our go-to is the AirPods Pro 3. AirPods sync seamlessly with Apple's smartphones, and the AirPods Pro 3 have foam-lined ear tips to improve comfort and passive noise isolation. You'll also get features like real-time translation, surprisingly accurate heart rate monitoring, up to eight hours of battery life, and an IP57 rating for water resistance.Photograph: Ryan WaniataSonyWH-1000XM6$460 $398 (13% off) Amazon$458 $398 (13% off) Walmart$458 $400 (13% off) Best BuyIf you don't want earbuds, our favorite wireless headphones are the Sony WH-1000XM6.
